name: The Honey Baked Ham Company
address: 2770 S McKenzie St, Foley, AL 36535, USA

reviews.author: Thomas Whitecastletonship
reviews.text:
15 stars total!
Food, outstanding!
Service, other-worldly!
Atmosphere, perfect!

There's truly not enough good things I can say about The HBH in foley. I had the turkey bacon ranch sandwich with potato salad. After the first bite I was taken to another place where all my worries faded into nothing and I felt whole as a person for the first time.

The potato salad was BETTER THAN MY MAMAS! That's saying a lot because she devoted her whole life to creating the perfect potato to salad ratio. Turns

reviews.author: Sandy Jones
reviews.text: Ive waited in line for over 4 hrs for a honeybaked ham in Denver Colorado in the past. This place is a ghost town however. I see why. Terrible customer service. I dont recommend this location to anyone. If good service is something you appreciate, I recommend you steer clear of Foley honeybaked ham and drive elsewhere!!!

reviews.author: Enni Lozada
reviews.text:
Jacob was such a sweetheart to help me pick the best cake for a special day. He even went out of his way to send a personal note which meant to much to me!

The cake was amazing and everyone was very happy with cake, but I was more amazed by their customer service

reviews.author: Lexi Hodges
reviews.text: incredibly delicious ham and sandwiches. they are running a weekly special deal for $9.99 with a sandwich, drink, and cookie right now. my favorite sandwich is “the honeybaked”. if you’re looking for a lowkey lunch spot, ham for a special occasion, or frozen dinner/sides, this is the place!

reviews.author: C Gehringer
reviews.text: Bought small ham for four people and roasted turkey. Spent $107. Ham was mostly FAT! Was embarrassed to serve  it for our company New Year's Year. Spent half hour cutting off FAT as we needed food for our company. Never have We had such a bad cut of Honey Baked Ham! Turkey was good! The lady never showed me the ham prior to wrapping it up which I thought was odd ( cameras should prove this). Can't recommend this place.

name: City Donut
address: 25751 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: STLA_1020
reviews.text: Huge selection of doughnuts, drinks, ice cream, and more. We came at 7:30 on a Monday and even getting them at the end of the day they were good. Cinnamon twist was my favorite of the three I got. I would pass on the cinnamon roll. The banana split was very good

reviews.author: Alyssa Campbell
reviews.text: The ladies were so patient with us while we tried to select from their large selection of donuts. They recommended a half dozen so we could try a few different options. These donuts are SO GOOD. We considered grabbing a box for the road back home. Our favorites were the maple bacon and the apple pie but, honestly, you can’t go wrong with any of them. We ended up eating about 6 of the 7 we ordered.

reviews.author: Amanda Rainer
reviews.text: On vacation in Orange Beach - these donuts were AMAZING!! Soft, fresh, everything you hope for! Every topping the kids could want, and the croissants and spoke fists were to die for! Store sweet and friendly service. Best of all - reasonable prices for absolutely delicious donuts! Can’t wait to try the milkshakes! A must stop!

reviews.author: Cheryl
reviews.text: Very friendly employee immediately helped us. He recommended donuts to us and the family served before us. There was a nice selection of donuts and they tasted great. The yeast donuts tasted like KK. Each donut was around $3. My 9-year-old had a cake donut and I warned her it wasn't yeast, but she ended up liking it. My husband had a chocolate topped glazed eclair. I had the raspberry filled plain donut. My daughter had a chocolate cake donut with chocolate chips on top of chocolate icing. When

reviews.author: Ren C
reviews.text: The donuts and boba were amazing! The staff was SO kind. Their prices are a little high for donuts in my opinion however we ended up going back here twice during our stay. The donuts are delicious, the atmosphere is amazing!!

name: Sam's Deli
address: 27122 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Russell Benefield Jr
reviews.text: Food was poorly prepared. Never had an issue with the breakfast but lunch was awful. BBQ sandwich was drowned in bbq sauce and the sandwich I had was soaked in horseradish mayo. Onion were definitely not sautéed and the meat was cold. So ended up feeding the meat to my dog.

reviews.author: Rachel Graham
reviews.text: Best store in Orange Beach.  There is nothing that you need that they don't have. Best muffins I have ever had. Clothing, groceries fishing supplies and gas too.

reviews.author: J.T. Baxter
reviews.text: Hopefully the owner has serious hormonal issues. I have never encountered such a beast!!  If I were starving I wouldn’t order from here ever again. As a customer of over 5 years the level of rudeness increases daily. It’s just a sandwich...Dayum I wish there was a negative star rating. 👎 ⭐️  I’m really going to miss that sandwich!!!

reviews.author: Kerri Vintson
reviews.text: Sam's Gas is $1.99 the cheapest in Orange Beach, they have a Great Fishing department, clothing and a deli..

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.text: Great place, Little bit pricey but they have almost anything that you need.

name: BuzzCatz Coffee & Sweets
address: 25689 Canal Rd Suite A, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Lexi G
reviews.text: Everything about this place is a cat lovers dream!! The vibes from the soft music to the friendly service to the cat puns located around the coffee shop are paw-sitively wonderful!! I got the hot chocolate and poptarts and they were both fresh and tasty.

reviews.author: EJ W
reviews.text: We enjoyed it at BuzzCatz. There were a few people, but things moved along fine. Lots of seating inside, out back, and on the patio. The omelets with ham and bacon were real good as well as the chai tea latte. The service people were fun and very friendly. Lots of other good things on the menu to check out. Put this place on your list.

reviews.author: Brady Middleton
reviews.text: We stopped by for a quick coffee and breakfast on our way out of town.  The nutella poptart and veggie quiche were phenomenal.  The King Cake latte was a little too sweet for our taste, but we're willing to go back.  The atmosphere was very relaxed and casual.  Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Ricky Payne
reviews.text: I could swim in the biscuits and gravy forever and die happy.  Pecan praline cinnamon roll was amazing as well.  Very friendly staff and awesome atmosphere.  Will definitely frequent when in the area.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: The blueberry glazed biscuit was divine. My husband loved the cinnamon roll breakfast sandwich. The biscuit breakfast sandwich was probably the best I've ever had. Great coffee, super friendly and quick despite being very busy.

name: Starbucks Coffee Company
address: 25773 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: G Hruby
reviews.text: I order the same drink at Starbucks around the USA and this particular location suffers with consistency compared to the rest.  The drink is the brown sugar shaken oat milk espresso.  The reason I ditched Dunkin for Starbucks was because of the lack of consistency they provide from store to store.  This particular location made a drink that was quite literally 85-90% ice.  I asked the second time through (on a different day, same week) if they could do something different, explaining that it was

reviews.author: M Godlewski
reviews.text: If you don’t have time to kill don’t come to this store in the morning!!  We arrived at 10:40 AM. It was a 2 minute wait to turn for parking in the lot because the drive thru is so backed up but I see why because the walk in wait they tell you at the register is 30 (thirty) minutes.    We waited around 16 minutes for our 2 drinks. Apparently there is a need for another Starbucks nearby!!!!  The employees were nice and all working hard but they have to much business at this store with  mobile, dr

reviews.author: Katrina Shoemaker
reviews.text: Ordered an iced mocha latte and it was the worst coffee I had in my life. Wasn’t even cold just seemed like they threw ice on top with no shaking and it didn’t even seem like the coffee was mixed together to be evenly distributed. As well the coffee cup broke while driving leaving a big mess in my car. 6$+ for a bad medium sized coffee then gonna ask if I wanna tip? Please go to local coffee shops not this flavorless overpriced company.

reviews.author: Crystal Harris
reviews.text: I stopped here while on a short trip in the area. I am not a Starbucks regular, but I needed to work on a laptop for a couple of hours and this was the perfect place for that! I ordered lunch and couple drinks that I thought sounded tasty. The staff were all great! The food was fresh and delicious, as were the drinks. Everyone's orders seemed to be completed impressively quick! While I was there, I heard them greet every customer with a warm welcome and even addressed several customers by name.

reviews.author: Tammy Odom
reviews.text: We work in Orange Beach and sometimes need to order breakfast to go. It’s never easy when it’s summertime at the beach, but to be July 4th as well. Ya might as well grab a book and hunker down. Today was a super busy line around the building kinda day. Cars were leaving the take out line and people seemed pretty tense. Totally a “please pack your patience” kinda mood. We were greeted by a barista with a great attitude and kind voice, even though she had already been handed a few unkind vibes. Sh

name: Dairy Queen Grill & Chill
address: 25741 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Barry Hart
reviews.text: We visit this location every Jan (snow birds).  Have always been impressed with the service.  Until last night.  Pulled in around 6:30 pm and ordered ice cream to go.  Asked for lids and a sack.  When ice cream arrived, there were no lids or a sack.  I reminded the young lady at the window that we needed lids and a sack. reviews.author: Tabitha McLaughlin
reviews.text: We stay at the Hampton Inn across the street when we are on vacation.  The food is always good and the staff is very friendly.  The ice cream is always amazing. I live about an hour away from the nearest Dairy Queen in Oklahoma so it is always a treat.  We frequentl this restaurant numerous times while we are on vacation.  Definitely will return and would recommend.

reviews.author: Susanna Pylant
reviews.text:
Ordered a couple of large Oreo blizzards at the drive thru for my husband and I with Heath Bar and Butterfinger added in. As we were pulling away, I took the spoon and stirred the blizzard around and saw there was barely anything at all mixed into it, and it was mostly just ice cream. Since we paid $21 for this, I parked the car, brought the blizzards back in and politely asked them to redo them, which they did.
That's when I opened Google reviews on this place and noticed the very low star rati

reviews.text: The burger was rather average, but I was very pleasantly surprised by the amazing cheese curds and onion rings. I’d go back for those. The service was rather lacking and I’m not sure if there was an issue with the microphone, or what, but the lady couldn’t hear us; even with turning off our vehicle which was rather quite to begin with. reviews.author: Kevin Webb
reviews.text:
Lazy and ignorant staff.
The lady with all the makeup on took my order.  Asked us to pull around to wait.   Took two more people's orders.  She finished cooking all three orders before bring out the food to all 3 customers.  Made us wait additional time for our order, because she was too lazy to get some steps in..    Terrible customer service and ignorance about anyone else in this world but herself.

name: Island Time Daiquiris & Pizza at The Wharf
address: 4830 Wharf Pkwy W G101, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Scot Surla
reviews.text: Normally have good service, will update if I return in the future. Drove from Fairhope, saw posted online 11am food available. Walked in at 12, saw 2 people at the bar eating and asked for the menu. Was told by bartender kitchen isn't open.

reviews.author: Tia Beauleau
reviews.text: April is the best bartender! It is our first time here and she made our entire night! The drinks were delicious too! For sure will be back!

reviews.author: Sara Beth Wade
reviews.text:
The bartender will ask you if you want to pay an extra $4 for an extra shot in your drink. What they mean is would you like some alcohol in your drink? Because there isn't hardly any in the mix I was given. It was the orange/cream one and it didn't taste good at all. I ended up throwing half of it out. Maybe the alcohol was in the bottom half...

Also, the band on the patio was a kiss/aerosmith-like arena rock band, which totally didn't fit in the the sunshiney outdoor patio setting.

reviews.author: Joshua Barnett
reviews.text: They got me one time with the OBA orange daiquiri that shit is dangerous...tried them all they are all well mixed and good flavor we stop in every time we come and will definitely be back

reviews.author: Brandon Williams
reviews.text:
Small little beer and daiquiri bar. They have a nice selection of drinks between daiquris and beers. What I liked about the place was it had quick service (I did not have to wait to be served), the bar tender was very polite and helpful. You have many different sized drink options and you can add an extra shot for $4. Prices were reasonable (a lot ofnplaces are much more expensive).

reviews.author: Autumn Bough (7autumn5)
reviews.text: We had breakfast and coffee. Surprisingly Southern Grind has the best bacon I’ve ever had in my life. We also had lovely outdoor seating which accommodated us with our little dog. While we were there the police chief came by to say hello and pet our dog! The coffee was amazing and we bought some whole bean coffee to take home. It was an excellent experience. You can’t get more southern hospitality than this place.

reviews.author: Alyssa Campbell
reviews.text: This is a cute little coffee shop located within The Wharf. It was one of the only shops open on Saturday morning. They have a nice selection of coffee beverages and breakfast/dessert items.

reviews.author: Reni
reviews.text: Went to this coffee shop awhile back on a girls trip in Orange Beach. The restaurant is connected to Hotel Indigo, but there is parking right outside of the coffee shop as well. If you are in the area and in search of a good breakfast/brunch spot…look no further.  Breakfast menu has a wide selection and there’s enough there to choose from to satisfy the pickiest of eaters. We ate here almost every day for breakfast and each time, we were highly satisfied with the service and quality of food. The

reviews.author: Brady Middleton
reviews.text: We had breakfast here multiple times on a recent trip to OB.  The biscuits and gravy are a hit as well as the french toast!  The coffee is phenomenal and the atmosphere is the ultimate beach theme.  We didn't purchase any gifts or items in the store, but they offer a wide range of unique, beach themed items to choose from.  100% will be back.

reviews.author: Justin Barnes
reviews.text: This is our first time checking out this place and what they were about. The staff was incredibly friendly and super helpful. I had the avocado toast with bacon and hot honey, it was delicious!!! My wife had the omelette with spinach and mushrooms. Incredibly good. The ambiance and environment Beverly chill and five with great outdoor seating. The coffee was stout and tasty. I'm a big fan and will be coming back for sure

reviews.author: Lemonade Milkshake
reviews.text: Quite the pleasant experience in this little gem of a beach haüs coffee haüs! ☕️ Lovingly ornamented w/ all kinds of seaside decor. 🌊⚓️🧭🐙🚢☀️Enjoyed the crème brûlée frappe & a futbol ⚽️ match on the big screen. Thanks for a much returnable experience!

reviews.author: Gianna Oliveri
reviews.text:
I really
Enjoyed this place a lot! They stop breakfast at 11am and start lunch at 11am. They had a lot of drink options for everyone caffeine and caffeine free drinks and big breakfast menu with alot of options as well as healthier options. They had tons of indoor and some outdoor seating and some shopping to do inside.

reviews.author: Lotsa Luck
reviews.text: Southern Grind is such a gem in Gulf Shores! The shop itself is super cute with a warm and welcoming vibe. The staff were incredibly friendly and personable, which made the experience even better. I ordered a latte and it was a 10/10—so good that I finished it before I even made it home! This place definitely deserves a spot on your coffee stop list if you’re in the area. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Katrina Ricker
reviews.text: Avocado toasts were really good with crispy thick pieces of bacon! The two coffees we got were also super good. Both were sweet coffees and a little strong on the syrup, but you were still able to taste the coffee. So good!

reviews.author: J H
reviews.text: I’ve been here a couple of times years ago and absolutely enjoyed it; however, this trip was a completely different experience and I was sadly disappointed.  No hot lattes (was a cold day), waited at counter without even a “hello” (as employees carried on their personal conversation), and zero enthusiasm taking our order. name: Shipp’s Dockside Grill
address: 27075 Marina Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Marlo Schofield
reviews.text: Our waiter was so fantastic! His service was amazing! So friendly and attentive. He said he was 22 but it seemed more like lucky 777’s 🍀! Five stars ! Thank you for a wonderful evening! Food was also delicious!

reviews.author: Pamela Pruett
reviews.text: Tajhe is an exceptional worker. I was impressed. Crab bisque was yummy. My filet mignon was butter melting in my mouth. Gravy was too salty and the French fried onion rings were not edible. Mashed potatoes we're good and didn't touch the green beans. The southern rum bread pudding was 1/2 a pan!!! Yum!!!!!

reviews.author: Eric Mealus
reviews.text: Wow, if the food taste matched the food looks this place would be fantastic.  Instead, we left a bit disappointed.  Of the three dishes we had at our table, the Grouper was the best of the three; both sides though were cold and the greens were on the sweet side.  The eggplant dish and the crab quesadilla dish were not worth every ordering again.  The eggplant was undercooked.  There was plenty of crab in the quesadilla and it was oddly tasteless.

reviews.author: jettt111
reviews.text: My gosh. We just ate here and got the Thursday filet mignon for old times sake. It was melt in your mouth tender , I got the tomato vinegarette dressing and it was the best ever. I added a lobster tail with melted butter and it was cooked perfectly. Our waitress was named “special “.  She was perfect with everything. It was a meal to remember.

reviews.author: Stephanie Thompson
reviews.text: This is our third year coming to the area and this was hands down the best meal we’ve had yet. The Creole and Rockefeller oysters were fantastic but the star of the show was the grouper pontchartrain. Best grouper we’ve ever had. The fried oyster salad was delicious as well. Our server Jocelyn was friendly and attentive. Wish we would have come here at the beginning of our vacation vs the end because we would definitely go back!

name: Coastal Orange Beach
address: 25722 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: CJ's Adventures
reviews.text:
If you are in Gulf Shores, AL, you have GOT to stop here at COASTAL.
Here, you will have some awesome food with the most amazing view!!
The waitress we had was sweet, but she was a little slow to check on us throughout our meal, so that's why I gave service a 4 star instead of 5. But, it was nowhere near the worst service we've ever had.
I got the Stuffed Blueberry French Toast (and I paid a little extra for a side of bacon and breakfast potatoes) and my husband got their Signature Coastal Burge

reviews.author: H. Hays
reviews.text:
What a wonderful lunch we had today at CoastAl in Perdido beach / Orange beach. We had lunch at the beach bar and where seated immediately by a very friendly host. Our waitress was out quickly with some waters and took our cocktail order. (World famous Bushwackers (see photos)).
For our entrees my wife ordered a bacon cheeseburger with fries, and I the fresh fish sandwich (they are caught in front of our condo every morning) with pasta salad. I had the choice of Mahi mahi (dolphinfish) or Groupe

reviews.author: Joshua Schmitt
reviews.text:
My Family is down from Wisconsin for a family vacation, and to celebrate my Daughter's birthday, and she was given the opportunity to pick the restaurant for her special night.  With all the places in the area, she landed on COASTAL, and I couldn't be happier with her decision!

Now this place does it right!  The property is beautiful and the branding is on point.  Not to mention, they also have a boutique style store that is a step above the quality and designs you see at the touristy shops.  F

reviews.author: Amina Sundberg
reviews.text: The atmosphere is very chill and aesthetic. Lots of cute places within to dine. The food is amazing. Our server Dakota was attentive to our needs, professional and gave great menu suggestions. The restaurant encapsulates the whole feel of the south.

reviews.author: Alejandra Terrazas
reviews.text:
This place is absolutely beautiful! If you sit on the inside patio, it’s even better, the view and atmosphere are perfect. The pimento cheese and burrata were both amazing. I loved the shrimp and crab chowder—it was flavorful, a little spicy, and had large chunks of crab. So delicious and comforting!

name: Crush
address: 4851 Wharf Pkwy E #D128, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Dana
reviews.text: Came here for a drink after a craft class at Orange Beach Library and I’m so glad we popped in! We had their Rioja (and I bought a bottle to bring home) and shared the burrata — their food is AMAZING! I just wish they stayed open later on weekends!

reviews.author: H. Hays
reviews.text: Great selection of wines. Beautiful wine bar. Tapas abound. Great Harbor view.

reviews.author: julie c
reviews.text: Wine selection at the bar is average and priced correctly. We ordered the cheese plate and liked the selection but the ratio of cheese that needs bread or crackers to eat because of the softness of it was way off. We had to leave cheese on the plate or eat it plain with a fork. The service is very poor. reviews.author: Raquel Del Rosario Mendez (TieDyeRosie)
reviews.text: This is a must see ! So many beautiful bottles

reviews.author: Natashia Lee
reviews.text: Super yummy food! Great place to talk and eat with friends.

name: Cafe Beignet of Alabama OB
address: 25405 Perdido Beach Blvd Suite 22, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Rafe Bar
reviews.text: Beignets, beignets, and more beignets. Very delicious, super fresh. Great service, and delicious beignets what more do I need to say. I didn’t think about it at the time but not sure if they have a dipping sauce, but that would have been a good addition, but obviously not needed because I ate everything without even thinking about it. Bring cash, sometimes the card machine goes down.

reviews.author: Vanity Tucker
reviews.text: We absolutely love this place. We have eaten here for breakfast 3x this week. It’s quick, easy, and delicious. My son may have ate 6 in one hour. If you want an affordable quick breakfast to take back to the condo I highly recommend. The workers are also super friendly! Our go to when we are in Orange Beach!

reviews.author: Robbie Lynn Johnson
reviews.text: The beignets had a different taste to them - the owner told me she's had the business over 30 years and just uses beignet mix but it was like the buttermilk was stronger than usual - very good.  Little hole in the wall type of restaurant in the Rouses shopping center.  We enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Tom W
reviews.text: Fabulous beignets! Got the filled ones and they were hot and delicious. Front staff woman was very friendly as well. Definitely will be back.

reviews.author: STLA_1020
reviews.text: Very fresh beignets! They seem made when you order. Very puffy and delicious. Different than NOLA but good. French vanilla iced Coffee was also delicious. The atmosphere is the only thing that could use some upgrading. Older gentleman posted out front, smoking cigars, gawking at women makes it less desirable.

name: Cafe Beignets of Alabama GS
address: 200 W Fort Morgan Rd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Andrea Van Someren
reviews.text: Yummy beignets, very old person vibe inside, keep to yourself, less joy, but hey the beignets were pretty good. Fresh or reheated a couple days later, so that’s a win!

reviews.author: Nick Norman
reviews.text: Cafe Beignets is a must stop every time we are in Gulf Shores! Best, Beignets in town! They even rival Beignets in New Orleans! They taste fresh every time, golden brown and just the right amount of powdered sugar. This is not some corporate giant company. This is a locally owned business. Please know that before coming. Sometimes they are cash only. I would rather support this small local business than a giant corporate chain any day.

reviews.author: Loving Living Green

reviews.author: lacey H
reviews.text:
My children and I were able to share fresh warm beignets both filled and original.
They were so warm, fluffy and delicious but the exceedingly joyful customer service is really what sets it off.
Thank you for making our trip so special!

reviews.author: Blair Bauer
reviews.text: I went in here with my grandfather yesterday morning and we had a good time! The beignets are very tasty and filling and the chocolate sauce is good as well. The staff was so kind and chatty. We love supporting local businesses. I wish they offered more dipping sauces and any kind of substantial food, because they really only offer coffee, beignets, and muffins which aren’t filling long term.

name: Foam Coffee
address: 313 E 22nd Ave, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Jesse Tischauser
reviews.text: Super cute little coffee shop with a surf shop vibe tucked away behind what looks like a nice little wine shop.  Definitely worth checking this spot out.  The toast flight was delish!  We’ll be back again for sho!

reviews.author: Lindy R
reviews.text: Their cappuccino is delicious (didn’t get a pic 😢) and the s’mores latte is so yummy!! Surf break burrito was tasty too! I’ll be returning any time I’m at the beach!

reviews.author: Sandra B
reviews.text: Best coffee shop around!!!! Others got nothing on this place. Latte was as delicious as expected and better!! Also got a turmeric, black pepper drink with coconut milk…sounds strange but it also was a delicious non coffee beverage. Lots of choices. Atmosphere was extremely clean surf vibe. Very upscale but prices were very reasonable. Get a simple beverage or the most spruced up, either way it will not disappoint!!!

reviews.author: Michael Hicks
reviews.text: I absolutely LOVE Foam! Every time I visit my parents in Gulf Shores I go every day I’m there. The iced Cuban is top notch, as is the brown sugar shaken espresso! They remembered my name when they were cashing me out at the register which gave a very personal, welcoming touch. The new space is also beautiful! Vibes are immaculate! I highly recommend!

As a tourist I was excited to see this gorgeous little coffee shop my daughter found on social media. We are new part time residents to the area and will NEVER be back to Foam. Only thing good was the pistachio matcha and plant life.

I do recommend the Foley Krispy Kreme.

reviews.author: Mac Temoteo

reviews.author: Christena Hasenbein

reviews.author: Kate Green

reviews.author: Shannon Ostrander
reviews.text:
Love love love this hidden gem! Located next to Coastal Carts and is definitely not one to pass up!

reviews.author: Riley Moody

reviews.author: Natalie Johnson
reviews.text: Got a few lattes here on a family vacation and they were all delicious! The cold foam is so good and creamy and the matcha was also so good.

GREAT DONUTS!

My only criticism is the prices are a bit high for the donuts and the plain coffee.

reviews.text:
Our family favorite is the fruit parfait, but a little pricey! The coffee is okay. The service was great and Ruby was so friendly! Always seems very clean and you can't beat the view.

reviews.author: Dan Snell
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Natalya Koetsier
